“Can an 8-person start-up sell to a CIO?”

24×7 support
No excuses for downtime
A dedicated account manager
Someone who knows the product cold, and can answer any question
And more. The CIO asked me if I knew of any 8-person start-ups that could sell to a CIO. And I said yes — but only if they understood this social contract. If you’re an 8-person start-up looking to sell to a CIO, here’s what I’d do:
First, understand the social contract
. Be there when they need you. Second, build trust
. Show them that you can be relied on. Third, focus on the value proposition
. What makes your product unique? Fourth, don’t overpromise
. You may not have all the features they want today, but if you’re honest about it and show a clear roadmap, they’ll appreciate it.
